description: Calculate the most efficient farming routes and progression paths in Mini War Roblox. Find out how to earn money fastest and level up your army.

activities.name: Basic Farm
activities.strategy: Start here to accumulate initial gold for factory upgrades.

activities.name: Factory Production
activities.description: Industrial income source. Requires factory building.
activities.strategy: Build factories early to unlock passive income. Prioritize upgrades.

activities.name: Resource Node
activities.strategy: Unlocks after first factory. Use worker mechs for efficiency.

activities.name: Military Mission
activities.strategy: Battle enemy bases for bonus gold. Bring tanks for heavy zones.

activities.name: Boss Raid
activities.strategy: Coordinate combined arms. Use helicopters for mobility, tanks for damage.

activities.name: Air Strike Operation
activities.strategy: Requires helicopter units. Best money per hour for air-focused players.

activities.name: Defense Contract
activities.description: Defend your base from waves. Passive but steady.
activities.strategy: Repel waves to earn contract bonus. Low risk steady income.

buildings.name: Farm
buildings.description: Basic income building. Generates passive gold over time.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.description: Trains infantry units. Required for military missions.

buildings.name: Mech Bay
buildings.description: Produces combat mechs. Essential for late-game progression.

buildings.name: Airport
buildings.description: Deploys helicopters. Unlocks air strike operations.

buildings.name: Military Base
buildings.description: Maximum military infrastructure. Enables boss raids.

progressionTips: Always upgrade your farm first — passive income compounds.
Factory unlocks at level 5 — prioritize reaching it.
Save gold for Combat Mechs — they dominate mid-game.
Helicopters unlock air strike missions at level 20.
Tanks are the most powerful single unit — prioritize if going heavy assault.
Diversify your army — combined arms always beats single unit spam.
